data.name: Hôtel Saint John Perse
data.address: 6FP7+2F2, Centre Saint John Perse La Darse FR, Pointe-à-Pitre 97110, Guadeloupe
data.description:
A 2-minute walk from Musée St-John Perse, this laid-back hotel in the heart of Old Pointe a Pitre is a 7-minute walk from Église Saint-Pierre et Saint-Paul and 7.5 km from Pointe-à-Pitre International Airport.
The relaxed, traditionally decorated rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges. Upgraded rooms add kitchenettes. Some rooms offer ocean views.
The hotel offers a free buffet breakfast. Other amenities include an airport shuttle (fee) and a casual restaurant.
